focus_and_action_dispatch.known_action_emitters_summary: Static dispatch callsites now cover all 13 action IDs from FocusKey through Inactive. Typed emitter methods independently identify DecideKey, Invalid, Check/Uncheck, RepeatKey/Touch, and Active/Inactive. Focus/UnFocus and DecideTouch callsites are located, but their physical event producers, final recipient/CNT1 binding, callback order, and timing remain unresolved. Touchscreen dataflow now statically connects HID sampling, hit-test, pointer-target recording, matching control-tree traversal, and indirect virtual callbacks; TouchSelect/TouchUnselect are recorded in a diagnostic message history, not proven as delivered receiver events.
